exposure: Maternal postpartum hemoglobin levels: no anemia (≥11 mg/dl), mild-to-moderate anemia (7-11 mg/dl), and severe anemia (<7 mg/dl)
finding: Children born to anemic mothers have an increased risk for pediatric neurological-related hospitalizations.
mod_finding: The study controlled for delivery mode as a confounding variable, but did not investigate mode of delivery as a primary or secondary outcome.
